name: Gettin' Buzzed
summary: A frontier camp wants wild honey for a barrel of drink. Kurll asks you to bring it from the wasp nests to the west.

sections.title: Honey for the Camp
sections.body: Kurll is looking to lift the camp's spirits with a barrel of good drink. He has a recipe taken from a slain dwarf and needs honey to make the brew. The wasp nests to the west hold what he needs.

faq.answer: Kurll needs wild honey for a brew made from a recipe he took from a dwarf.
The wild honey is in wasp nests to the west.
Kurll wants honey for a brew that he hopes will lift the camp's spirits.
Kurll says he took a recipe for a delicious brew from a dwarf he killed.
